Rocket: Which rocket is it?
Rocket. The board has 10x10 sites (160x160 cells). The window shows one site; each move goes to the next site (up, down, left or right). One large rocket lies across a plain white board. Four parts sit in their places, each drawn as one big black shape filling one site: its nose at the top right corner: a black disc or a black triangle pointing up; its two windows side by side in the middle: a wide flat black bar or a black V shape; its fins at the bottom left corner: a black eight-point star or a black ring; its flame at the bottom right corner: a tall thin black bar or three flat black stripes. Every other site shows plain white. The whole rocket may sit one site higher, lower, left or right. Question: Which rocket is it? The answer is one of eight rockets, each with its own parts: arrow = a black disc, a wide flat black bar, a black eight-point star, a tall thin black bar; comet = a black disc, a wide flat black bar, a black ring, three flat black stripes; dart = a black disc, a black V shape, a black eight-point star, three flat black stripes; falcon = a black disc, a black V shape, a black ring, a tall thin black bar; hawk = a black triangle pointing up, a wide flat black bar, a black eight-point star, three flat black stripes; lance = a black triangle pointing up, a wide flat black bar, a black ring, a tall thin black bar; spark = a black triangle pointing up, a black V shape, a black eight-point star, a tall thin black bar; swift = a black triangle pointing up, a black V shape, a black ring, three flat black stripes. Answer with its name. You may answer at any time; you do not need to see every site. Score: 20 if the answer is right, minus 10, minus 0.1 per move (movement budget 35).
The answers: 1 = arrow, 2 = comet, 3 = dart, 4 = falcon, 5 = hawk, 6 = lance, 7 = spark, 8 = swift.
